t: You're standing at the monument to John Galsworthy in Highgate Cemetery, a twentieth-century memorial in north London. Galsworthy was an English novelist and playwright, best known for The Forsyte Saga, a trilogy of novels. He went on to write two further trilogies, A Modern Comedy and End of the Chapter. In 1932 he was awarded the Nobel Prize in Literature, and this monument commemorates him here.
